scope:
Native retained-trim flow through success/failure, restore, actuator and delivery.

Prescribed balanced observations at 48 Hz; controller/actuator memory is carried
independently. Observations are not integrated flight or a reachable envelope.
The zero-FM-timestep controller fixture skips moving inner prediction; controller
elapsed time and the explicit actuator step are nonzero. Owner restore executes
with the original snapshot producer/consumer. Only actor publication is stubbed.
